verdict.rationale: The docs describe single transfers: payouts and disbursements from a custodial account to onchain addresses, email recipients, or bank rails, with per-transfer lifecycle tracking. Nothing shows a batch or bulk payout API that pushes many payouts in one documented operation with per-item status. Single transfers are an adjacent capability, not mass disbursement.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
